Identity is proven, not labelled. provenance.resolve reads remote (git remote.origin.url), revision (git rev-parse HEAD) and digest (git ls-tree -r <rev> -- <skill root>) from the root; os.path.isdir decides nothing. The old cell_matrix.py:216 isdir relabel is gone.

The release oracle is independent of the claim. repository_release carries identity_proven, proven_repository, label_matches_provenance and release_refused; own_repository_released requires identity_proven AND proven_repository == declared repository AND the existing foreign-module/path facts. A label cannot outrank the evidence.
